tools.name: list_resumes
tools.title: List resumes
tools.description: Lists the user's WorkHunt resumes, newest first. The baseline resume is the one tailoring starts from.

tools.name: get_resume
tools.title: Get a resume
tools.description: Gets one resume's full content. A tailored resume that is still being written has status 'generating'; its preview updates by itself when it is ready, with no further call needed.

resumeId.description: The resume id, from list_resumes or tailor_resume.

tools.name: create_baseline_resume
tools.title: Save baseline resume
tools.description: Saves the user's resume to WorkHunt as their baseline - the resume tailoring starts from - so tailor_resume can run. Call it only when the user has no baseline resume and has pasted or typed their own resume in this chat; pass that text in full and unchanged. Never write, summarize, guess or embellish a resume yourself, and never pass a job posting. WorkHunt reads the text into its resume structure without adding anything. It only ever adds a resume: if the user already has a baseline it changes nothing and says so. Does not use a daily AI analysis. Returns the saved resume; ask the user to check it, then continue with tailor_resume.

resumeText.description: The user's resume as plain text, exactly as they provided it in this chat.

tools.name: tailor_resume
tools.title: Tailor resume to a job
tools.description: Creates a new resume tailored to a job posting, starting from the user's baseline resume. Pass the full job description text, or jobUrl when the user shares only a link: WorkHunt reads the page, and if the site blocks that (LinkedIn, SEEK and some others do) the error says to ask the user for the text. Uses one of the user's daily AI analyses. If the same posting was already tailored today, the existing resume is returned (`reused` true) and no analysis is spent; say it is the one from earlier, not a new version. Returns the tailored resume, or status 'generating' if it is still being written: the preview then fills in by itself when it is ready, with no further call needed. If the user has no baseline resume, ask them to paste their resume text (then call create_baseline_resume) or to use the link in the error. The returned sessionId is used by generate_cover_letter and generate_interview_prep. Also names the session after the job. It does not track the application; to track it, call list_applications first and update a matching entry (a saved one moves to tailored) or add_application with this sessionId. `match` is null while the comparison is still running: say the score is in WorkHunt, never invent one. `remainingToday` is how many tailorings are left today after this one (null = unknown); say so when it is 0 or 1. `plan` is free, pass or company (an employer seat). `match.baselineMatchScore` is how well the user's baseline resume (before tailoring) fits the job; never present it as the tailored resume's score.

jobDescription.description: The full text of the job posting. Leave it out only when passing jobUrl.

jobTitle.description: Optional short name for this job, e.g. 'Senior Engineer at Acme'.

company.description: The hiring company's name, only if the posting or the user states it.

jobUrl.description: A link to the job posting, when the user shares a link instead of the text. It is also saved as the posting's link.

tools.name: list_tailoring_sessions
tools.title: List tailored jobs
tools.description: Lists the jobs the user has tailored a resume for, newest first, each with the sessionId that generate_cover_letter, get_cover_letter, generate_interview_prep and get_interview_prep take. Use it in a new chat to find an earlier job by company or role. Read-only and spends no AI analysis. Chats that never analyzed a job are not listed. If several jobs match, ask the user which one; if none match, say so rather than tailoring again.

query.description: Optional words from the company or job title, e.g. 'Airwallex'. Omit to list all.

tools.name: generate_cover_letter
tools.title: Write a cover letter
tools.description: Writes a cover letter for a job already tailored with tailor_resume (pass its sessionId; in a new chat, find it with list_tailoring_sessions). Returns the letter, or status 'generating' if it is still being written: an inline preview then fills in by itself; where there is no preview, call get_cover_letter once. If the session already has a cover letter it is returned unchanged, never rewritten (the user can regenerate it in WorkHunt).

sessionId.description: The sessionId from tailor_resume or list_tailoring_sessions.

tools.name: get_cover_letter
tools.title: Get a cover letter
tools.description: Gets the cover letter for a tailoring session, if one has been written. In a new chat, find the sessionId with list_tailoring_sessions.

sessionId.description: The sessionId from tailor_resume or list_tailoring_sessions.

tools.name: generate_interview_prep
tools.title: Generate interview prep
tools.description: Generates interview preparation for a job tailored with tailor_resume (needs a WorkHunt pass; get_account_status says whether the user has one): likely interview questions, a company brief and recruiter-screen scripts by default. Only missing sections are generated; sections that already exist are returned as they are (the user can regenerate them in WorkHunt). If pending is non-empty, call again with sections set to pending to generate the rest. In a new chat, find the sessionId with list_tailoring_sessions.

sessionId.description: The sessionId from tailor_resume or list_tailoring_sessions.

sections.description: Optional subset to generate: questions, company_brief, recruiter_scripts, day_of, technical_challenges, resume_coaching.

tools.name: get_interview_prep
tools.title: Get interview prep
tools.description: Gets the interview preparation already generated for a tailoring session (needs a WorkHunt pass). In a new chat, find the sessionId with list_tailoring_sessions.

sessionId.description: The sessionId from tailor_resume or list_tailoring_sessions.

tools.name: list_applications
tools.title: List job applications
tools.description: Lists the job applications the user is tracking in WorkHunt, newest first.

status.description: Optional status filter: saved, tailored, applied, screening, interview, offer, rejected, withdrawn, ghosted.

tools.name: get_application
tools.title: Get a job application
tools.description: Gets one tracked job application. Includes the notes added with add_application_note as timelineNotes (newest first, up to 20), separate from the free-form notes field.

tools.name: add_application
tools.title: Track a job application
tools.description: Adds a job application to the user's WorkHunt tracker. Pass sessionId/resumeId from tailor_resume to link the tailored resume, and postingUrl when the user shared the job's link. A session already tracked returns its existing application unchanged.

status.description: Status: saved, tailored, applied, screening, interview, offer, rejected, withdrawn, ghosted. Defaults to applied.

nextDate.description: Next step date, e.g. an interview, ISO 8601. Optional.

nextTime.description: Time of the next step on the user's own clock, 24-hour HH:mm (e.g. 14:30). Optional; needs nextDate in the same call.

resumeId.description: resumeId of the resume sent. Optional.

postingUrl.description: The job posting's link, http or https. Optional.

tools.name: update_application_status
tools.title: Update application status
tools.description: Moves a tracked application to a new status, e.g. from applied to interview, and can set its next step date at the same time.

status.description: New status: saved, tailored, applied, screening, interview, offer, rejected, withdrawn, ghosted. Pass the current status to change only the date.

nextDate.description: Next step date, e.g. an interview, ISO 8601. Optional; omitted keeps the current one.

nextTime.description: Time of the next step on the user's own clock, 24-hour HH:mm (e.g. 14:30). Optional; needs nextDate in the same call.

tools.name: add_application_note
tools.title: Add a note to an application
tools.description: Adds a note to a tracked application's timeline, e.g. who the user spoke to or what was agreed. Existing notes are kept. get_application returns them in timelineNotes.

annotations.title: Add a note to an application

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.title: Check plan and daily limit
tools.description: Gets the user's WorkHunt plan and today's tailoring allowance: tailoringsLeftToday of dailyLimit, and when the count resets (resetsAt, midnight Sydney time). plan is 'free', 'pass' or 'company' (an employer seat). Read-only and spends no AI analysis. Call it when the user asks about limits, plans or price, and before tailoring several jobs. passesFrom is the lowest current pass price; null means unknown, so never guess a price. passesOnSale is null when unknown. passEndsAt is null on the free plan or a company seat. Mention a pass only when the user is at or near a limit or asks; share upgradeUrl as given.
